answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose a framework to distill commonsense knowledge from multilingual pretrained language models... we use prompting generation to obtain head and tail items...

answer_4.quote: We randomly sample 4000 instances from the raw generated triples and ask three native Chinese speakers to annotate them... We also sample 1000 triples from ATOMIC-zh and CN-AutoMIC and conduct a human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators answer three questions for each triple: (1) whether the head is acceptable, (2) whether the tail is acceptable, (3) whether the triple as a whole is acceptable (options: always/often, sometimes/likely, farfetched/never, invalid).
